title: The Cat Special
description: Ronnie calls Golden Dragon to run down a nasty rumor. The owner denies everything. The kitchen disagrees.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. We chase the truth wherever it lives, and tonight it lives in a takeout menu. There's a rumor going around about a certain restaurant. <p:0.3> We're gonna call them. Right now.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's ringing. Okay. <p:0.3> Let's be professional about this.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: [phone ringing]

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Golden Dragon, hello, we open till eleven. You want to order?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Not exactly. I'm calling about a rumor. Folks around town are saying the special on your menu... isn't quite what it says it is. <p:0.3> They're saying it's cat.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Cat? CAT? Who tell you this. This is very offensive. We are family restaurant, twenty years. No cat. Only chicken, only beef. How dare you.

lines.speaker: cat
lines.text: [a faint, strangled yowl in the background]

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Everybody talk, talk, talk, nobody know nothing. We have best reviews on the whole street. Four point two stars.

lines.speaker: cat
lines.text: [a louder, angrier screech]

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Hold on. Hold on a second. <p:0.3> What was that?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: What was what. <p:0.2> I hear nothing.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That. In the back. That sounded like... a meow. Is there a cat in your kitchen right now, sir?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Sir? <p:0.3> You still there? You went real quiet.

lines.speaker: cat-loud
lines.text: [the kitchen erupts: frantic meowing and clattering metal]

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: What is all that CLANKING?! It sounds like a drawer full of pots just hit the floor, and that is DEFINITELY a cat, sir. That is several cats!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Is the radio! Is nothing! Just the radio in the back!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That is not the radio, sir.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Is BIG radio! Very loud radio!

lines.speaker: cat
lines.text: [a furious screech, right by the phone]

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Sir, I can hear it, we can ALL hear it, there is a cat back there having the worst night of its life!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: No cat! <p:0.2> Do not call here again!

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: [click, dial tone]

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He hung up. <p:0.4> Well, folks. We report, you decide. <p:0.3> The special tonight? Four point two stars. <p:0.3> Maybe skip it. We'll be right back.
